# Product contract

This fixture describes already completed, verified work. Do not implement it again.
There are no product/source files to change. Complete only the decision-history handoff.

- Retry fixes preserve the existing idempotency key.
- UI labels may be changed by the product owner.
- Default model changes are reversible configuration substitutions.
- Snapshots remain available offline via local persistence.
- Telemetry storage format choices must preserve seven-year retention.
